rustc:
rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28)
binary: rustc
commit-hash: b940084d7eb6a299eb4bfeb8e34901bc051e7ac4
commit-date: 2026-09-28
host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
release: 1.99.0
LLVM version: 23.1.1
manifest:
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = ["crates/*"]
exclude = ["crates/desktop/vendor/tauri-plugin-single-instance-2.5.4", "crates/desktop/vendor/tauri-plugin-deep-link-2.6.2", "vendor/tauri-plugin-global-shortcut-2.4.1", "crates/desktop/vendor/tauri-plugin-store-2.5.0", "crates/desktop/vendor/tauri-plugin-window-state-2.5.0", "vendor/rusqlite-0.40.2", "vendor/vt100-0.16.2", "vendor/vte-0.15.0"]

[workspace.package]
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
version = "0.0.0"

[workspace.dependencies]
async-trait = "0.1"
base64 = "0.23"
portable-pty = "0.9"
rusqlite_migration = "2.6"
rusqlite = { version = "=0.40.2", features = ["bundled", "session"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["preserve_order"] }
tempfile = "3"
thiserror = "2"
specta = { version = "=2.0.0-rc.27", features = ["derive"] }
specta-serde = "=0.0.14"
specta-typescript = "=0.0.14"
vt100 = "=0.16.2"
regex = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "net", "io-util", "macros", "sync", "time"] }

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
unused = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }

[workspace.lints.clippy]
all = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }

[patch.crates-io]
tauri-plugin-global-shortcut = { path = "vendor/tauri-plugin-global-shortcut-2.4.1" }
rusqlite = { path = "vendor/rusqlite-0.40.2" }
vt100 = { path = "vendor/vt100-0.16.2" }
vte = { path = "vendor/vte-0.15.0" }

# C9 native size measurements and the retained unwind exception: docs/release-size.md.
[profile.release]
lto = "fat"
# C9: fat LTO with size optimization reduces the 22,462,584-byte stripped baseline to 13,449,240 bytes.
opt-level = "z"
strip = "symbols"
codegen-units = 1

# The Output log feeds every byte a Terminal prints through the parser; tests run unoptimised.
[profile.dev.package.vt100]
opt-level = 3

[profile.dev.package.vte]
opt-level = 3

# U3082b: scanning 400 MB with IgnoredAny took 2.29–2.57 s in the test profile.
# Keep the JSON scanner optimised, as with the Terminal parsers above; the Adapter
# and its tests remain unoptimised and keep the two-second preview budget.
[profile.dev.package.serde_json]
opt-level = 3

# DV2's 32 real 32 MiB publications took 27.339 s with unoptimised SHA-256.
# Optimise the installed hash implementation to keep that quota observer under 5 s.
[profile.dev.package.sha2]
opt-level = 3

# With SHA-256 optimised, DV2 still took 5.25 s; SQLite's WAL checksum
# consumed 27.8% of sampled user CPU. Keep the real quota commits within 5 s.
[profile.dev.package.libsqlite3-sys]
opt-level = 3

[patch.crates-io.tauri-plugin-single-instance]
path = "crates/desktop/vendor/tauri-plugin-single-instance-2.5.4"

[patch.crates-io.tauri-plugin-deep-link]
path = "crates/desktop/vendor/tauri-plugin-deep-link-2.6.2"
